renderer.grammar: sankey-beta header; strict two-space indented CSV link rows source,target,value with printable free-text node labels and a bounded positive integer value
renderer.theme_gate: a column-0 frontmatter fence carrying any top-level key besides description, or an indented/unclosed fence, keeps the whole original on source fallback

selection.rule: sankey fixtures without a config/theme frontmatter gate; only the description-only sankey-beta original is reachable

review.reviewer_agent: independent read-only adversarial review (general-purpose agent a397660, D-211 sankey renderer cohort, 2026-11-14; APPROVE on re-review)
review.note: APPROVE after one re-review. First pass returned REQUEST CHANGES on one MAJOR and one MINOR, both resolved. MAJOR: an engine %%{init ...}%% directive was silently swallowed as a plain comment; the parser now rejects any line whose comment begins with %%{ while plain %% comments still pass, matching the agentflow/relations/packet/eventmodeling convention. MINOR: indented or non-exact column-0 --- fences are now gated in C++ exactly as the renderer-free generator classifies them (malformed fence). Two residual C++/Python divergences are reviewed as fail-safe NITs and documented in code: any non-exact line containing --- is gated (stricter than strip()=="---"), and any tab anywhere rejects (generator checks leading tabs only); both can only reject to fallback, never mis-draw, and both are unreachable on the pinned 18-fixture corpus. Independent probes through the public render_markdown seam measured the true partition 1 drawn / 17 config-gated / 0 error identically on debug, release -O2 and ASan+UBSan, with no 240/40-column width drift; the 17 gated fixtures are all plain sankey dialect carrying config.sankey layout/color contracts. A 40+ shape fail-closed battery (field counts, quotes, embedded commas, non-numeric/zero/negative/fractional/oversized values, empty labels, control bytes, odd indentation, unclosed fences, config/theme keys) behaves as intended; gas and bounds verified (512-link cap, 65536 source cap, value <= 999999999, monotonic Work spend). Neighboring family cohorts (agentflow 5/5, packet 7/7, probe 12/12) stay green; no shared module or established public contract changed.
